named: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE production game portrait ATLAS, a strictly aligned 4-column by 2-row grid, eight equal rectangular cells, no gaps or borders, all cells fully filled. Wide 4:3 canvas, ideally 2048x1536. Each cell is an individual bust portrait, head and torso fully contained, face placed at 45% cell height, for a Three Kingdoms ghost-war character card UI. All characters are adults. Read cells LEFT TO RIGHT then top to bottom: 1 Lü Bu 吕布, 2 Zhang Liao 张辽, 3 Gao Shun 高顺, 4 Chen Gong 陈宫; second row 5 Cao Chun 曹纯, 6 Cao Xiu 曹休, 7 Zang Ba 臧霸, 8 Hou Cheng 侯成. Refer to the recognizable character appearances in the manhua The Ravages of Time 火鳳燎原, with angular individualized faces, meaningful facial hair, scholarly vs soldier bearing, practical layered late-Han armor and robes. Reference image 1 is the author's published White Gate Tower volume cover, for face/garment ink character; reference image 2 is the author's Cao Chun illustration: preserve his thin mustache and pointed small beard, engraved central helmet band, segmented cheekguards, dark cloak. Lü Bu: fiercely handsome mature commander, swept tied dark hair, long pheasant plumes, severe proud eyes, dark red cloak and weathered scale armor, halberd shaft at edge. Zhang Liao: young stern lean commander with distinctive raised dark hair, green-black armor. Gao Shun: thick-necked stocky veteran, square jaw, severe face, heavy dark armor. Chen Gong: astute narrow-eyed middle-aged scholar, mustache and short beard, tall modest black scholar cap, ivory-gray robes. Cao Xiu: young alert commander, blue-gray cloak and helmet. Zang Ba: weathered mountain outlaw general, coarse beard and rough hide/lamellar. Hou Cheng: mature sturdy armored officer, tied hair and short beard. Rendering: intricate confident black ink lines, fine crosshatching, muted painted washes, smoky olive-gray ruined-city backgrounds, warm ivory faces, deep red/teal accents. Grounded historical fantasy, faint ghostly cold light, dignified and dramatic. Consistent close framing and lighting across all eight. NO text, NO names, NO numbers, NO UI, NO card frames, NO logos, NO watermarks, NO text from reference cover. This will be sampled as eight equal AtlasTexture regions, so absolutely strict 4x2 grid and no overlapping cell boundaries.
common: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE production game portrait ATLAS, a strict 3-column by 2-row grid, six equal tall rectangular cells, no gaps, no frame. Square overall canvas, ideally 1536x1536; each cell 512x768. Every cell shows one distinct ADULT late-Han Chinese commoner or soldier from head to chest, used as character-card illustration in a ruined Three Kingdoms ghost-war game. Reading left to right then top to bottom: 1 weary village militia swordsman with tied cloth headband, rough lamellar, iron dao and round wood shield edge; 2 lean young adult spearman with coarse headcloth and a spear shaft at side; 3 wiry adult hunter archer with straw cape, topknot, bow and quiver; 4 adult cavalry scout with weathered iron helmet and red scarf, no horse necessary; 5 older traveling Taoist talisman master with narrow lined face, white-gray beard, dark cloth hat and muted ocher robes, fingers holding a blank paper talisman with no writing; 6 kind sturdy middle-aged traveling physician, plain blue-gray robe, cloth cap, satchel, a small herb bundle. Highly differentiated faces. Intricate black ink drawing, clean strong manhua character silhouettes, fine crosshatching and subdued watercolor/painted color, smoky desaturated jade and brown background, warm faces, mature historical illustration rather than glossy 3D game art. Consistent portrait framing, each face high and large and entirely in its own cell, look slightly toward viewer. NO letters, text, numbers, logos, UI or card frames. Exact evenly divided 3x2 grid is essential for engine AtlasTexture sampling.
companions: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE production portrait ATLAS, exactly 4 columns by 3 rows, twelve equal tall cells, no gaps, no frame. Overall landscape 4:3 canvas ideally 2048x1536, each cell has one close head-and-torso portrait fully contained with clear face and distinct silhouette. ALL characters are adults aged 25 or older. Chinese historical fantasy game about ruined Three Kingdoms cities and ghosts, grounded finely inked manhua drawing with subtle painterly colors, coherent soft warm light on faces and muted jade/red/brown accents on quiet smoky backgrounds. Reading left to right then top to bottom: row 1: (1) Jia Weisuo 贾苇索, ORIGINAL protagonist, adult roguishly handsome Chinese man, tied long black hair, amused confident grin, simple charcoal martial robe, faded red scarf, coils of reed rope at shoulder, vigorous heroic bearing. (2) Lü Lingqi 吕玲绮, adult warrior princess, long black high ponytail and subtle small pheasant-feather hair ornament, sharp intelligent eyes, red-and-black light lamellar, dignified defiant face, influenced by a Three Kingdoms manhua warlord family. (3) adult traveling Western swordswoman, auburn hair, muted silver cuirass over dark cloak. (4) adult female healer, dark hair loosely tied, blue-green plain silk and linen robes, medical satchel. row 2: (5) mature ghost-market woman merchant, elegant high bun, dark plum silk, small coin purse; (6) adult Taoist priestess, black hair with simple wooden hairpin, ivory and dark blue robes, ritual bell; (7) adult city-defense crossbowwoman, brown ponytail, teal padded armor and crossbow partly visible; (8) adult woman bandit leader, cropped dark hair with red bandana, worn leather and dark red cloak, confident smile. row 3: (9) adult woman blacksmith, dark tied hair, olive tunic and leather apron, soot on cheek, strong arms and small hammer; (10) adult elegant singer, elaborate but sober dark bun, rose/cream hanfu, folding fan at chest, quietly inviting gaze; (11) adult female scribe, black hair neatly coiled, jade-gray robe, bamboo scroll at side; (12) male military cook, jovial sturdy middle-aged Chinese man, cloth cap, earth-toned robe and apron, wooden ladle. Fully clothed, no nudity, no suggestive poses. Fine facial features, expressive individualized faces, no generic same face. NO TEXT, no names, no writing, no badges, no card borders, no logos. Strict aligned 4x3 grid, no character overlapping neighboring cells. The atlas cells will be cropped by the game engine, so the characters must be centered inside their cells.
